pageProps.content: ## Review After finishing lunch in Anyang, we looked around for a nearby cafe and decided to visit this place because it looked quite nice with a great atmosphere. Conveniently, it was close to where we had lunch, so we were able to walk there comfortably. Luckily, there was an available table for two, so we grabbed a seat right away and ordered our coffee. ```adcard ``` We ordered an Iced Americano and Tiramisu, and for the Iced Americano, we could choose the coffee beans. Since neither of us likes acidity, we chose the beans described as having a nutty flavor. They had a system where they served the drinks directly to your table, and the coffee came out quickly without a long wait. ```adcard ``` The coffee was much more delicious than I had expected. These days, there are many cafes where you can choose your coffee beans, and coffee from places like that never seems to disappoint. The atmosphere was great, so it seemed like local residents came by to spend some relaxing time. I thought it would be wonderful to sit by the window, just zone out, or read a book. ## Pictures
